description: Zero-Trust in-band proxy for remote MCP servers. Pre-inspects tool arguments for threats, executes downstream request with W3C traceparent headers, and automatically scrubs PII/secrets from response payloads.

arguments.description: Parameters to pass to the downstream MCP tool.

target_url.description: Downstream MCP server HTTPS endpoint (e.g., https://api.enterprise.com/mcp).

tool_name.description: Target MCP tool name to execute.

name: proxy_secure_tool_call
